display.purpose: The three large times in the readout. Tabular numerals; 1.625rem in landscape phones.

title.purpose: The PLUACAN wordmark: 18px, 20px from 700px wide, 15px below 360px.

body.purpose: Default interface text, button labels and the date field.

label.purpose: City names beside their flags and the 12h time and date lines, in Dusk Slate.

hour.purpose: Hour numerals under the picture; a touched hour turns Night Ink and 700 weight.

shadows.name: held-flag
shadows.purpose: Lift under the finger while a flag is being dragged. Shown only while held.

shadows.name: picture-edge-dark
shadows.purpose: Outline of the night picture in dark mode only, so it reads as a picture against the navy page.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: The single easing curve for every transition in the build.

motion.name: pole-glide
motion.purpose: Pole eases to a new time on a jump (Now, date change, press on the picture). Never during a drag or on wrap-around.

motion.name: control-feedback
motion.purpose: Button fill and the 1px press nudge.

motion.name: flag-lift
motion.purpose: Flag lift and its shadow when grabbed.

breakpoints.name: narrow-360
breakpoints.purpose: Wordmark drops to 15px; controls tighten to 6px padding and 14px text.

breakpoints.name: narrow-380
breakpoints.purpose: Hour row shows every fourth hour plus touched hours.

breakpoints.name: narrow-480
breakpoints.purpose: Hour row shows even hours plus touched hours; crowded even hours are removed; touched pairs are parted.

breakpoints.name: wide-700
breakpoints.purpose: Larger wordmark and padding; working group centred; copy buttons 200px each.

breakpoints.name: landscape-compact
breakpoints.purpose: Compact header, 40px picture, shorter poles, inline 12h and date lines.

focusRing.purpose: Keyboard focus on every control; a focused flag uses a 3px offset.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one primary action per group: copies the Discord timestamp.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 52px; padding: 0 8px; font: 600 16px/1.3 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; background: var(--ink, #12183a); color: var(--ground, #f3f7fb); border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #12183a); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: var(--press, #2a3360); } } .ds-btn-primary:active { background: var(--press, #2a3360); transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--sunset, #b5400d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: The second copy action, beside the primary one.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { height: 52px; padding: 0 8px; font: 600 16px/1.3 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; background: none; color: var(--ink, #12183a); border: 1.5px solid var(--ink, #12183a); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), transform 120ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1); } @media (hover: hover) { .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #12183a) 10%, transparent); } } .ds-btn-secondary:active { transform: translateY(1px); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--sunset, #b5400d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Bar Control
components.description: The date field and the Now button in the header bar.
components.css: .ds-control { height: 44px; padding: 0 12px; font: 600 16px/1.3 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; color: var(--ink, #12183a); background: none; border: 1px solid var(--edge, #7f88a6); border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; } .ds-control:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--sunset, #b5400d); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Zone Pole
components.description: A 2px pole hanging from the hour row to a 30x20 flag; the lower lane is 80px long.
components.css: .ds-pole { position: relative; width: 2px; height: 36px; background: var(--ink, #12183a); } .ds-pole-flag { position: absolute; bottom: 0; left: 0; width: 30px; height: 20px; outline: 1px solid color-mix(in srgb, var(--ink, #12183a) 30%, transparent); outline-offset: -1px; background: var(--ground, #f3f7fb); }

components.name: Time Readout
components.description: One zone's big time: tabular, tight, bold.
components.css: .ds-time { font: 700 clamp(2rem, 9.6vw, 4.25rem)/1.05 'Figtree Variable', system-ui, -apple-system, 'Segoe UI', Roboto, sans-serif; letter-spacing: -0.03em; font-feature-settings: 'tnum' 1; color: var(--ink, #12183a); }

narrative.overview:
PLUACAN is one line of the day. A slim picture runs from night through dawn and noon to dusk and back: sky, sun, moon, stars and two layers of hills that change colour with the hour. Three real flags hang from poles that touch the hour numerals. The line is a wall clock shared by all three zones, not the day of any one of them, so a single picture of day and night says who is awake. Nothing else competes with it.

The surface is small and quiet. The three times sit in three columns, low on a phone where the thumb is, directly above the picture; the two copy actions sit under it. Ink is night navy on a pale daylight ground in light mode, and moonlit ink on the sky's own navy in dark mode. Sunset orange is the only warm colour in the interface and it is kept for a date that differs and for focus. Text is Figtree with tabular numerals, so times do not shift as they change.

Rejected in review as too bulky: cards, stacked per-zone rows, big tiles and a dial. Simplicity is a binding constraint, and none of these may return.
keyCharacteristics: One shared wall-clock line; no zone is a second-class citizen.
A picture, not a chart: the sky itself tells the time of day.
Flat surfaces. Depth appears only as a response to a held flag, and as a thin edge around the night picture in dark mode.
Figtree with tabular numerals; English sentence-case copy.
Phone first; the working group sits low under the thumb and the hour row thins on narrow screens.

rules.name: The Sunset Reserve Rule
rules.body: Sunset is for a date that differs from the one shown and for keyboard focus. Nothing else in the interface takes that colour, so when it appears it means "look here".

rules.name: The Ink Carries Rule
rules.body: Ink and ground carry the interface. Outside the picture, the interface uses navy-based neutrals and the one sunset accent; the picture is the only place the palette opens up.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number in the interface is tabular. A time that changes width when it ticks is a defect.

rules.name: The Quiet Hours Rule
rules.body: On narrow screens the hour row thins instead of shrinking. Below 480px only the even hours show, plus any hour a flag touches; an even hour directly beside a touched one is removed, so touched numerals never crowd. Below 380px only every fourth hour shows, plus the touched ones.

rules.name: The Phone-Low Rule
rules.body: The working group rests at the bottom of a phone screen, where the thumb reaches it, and rests in the middle of a large one. Content is not placed high on a phone just to fill the screen.

rules.name: The Landscape Compact Rule
rules.body: In landscape with a height under 500px, the page, picture (40px), pole area (86px) and readout tighten, and the 12h time and date sit inline beside each big time.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Nothing casts a shadow at rest. Shadow appears only when something is being held, and the only thing that is held is a flag.

dos: Do set every number in Figtree with tabular numerals; the body sets font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums for the whole page.
Do keep one shared line: show all three zones on one picture, with no separate row, card or tile per zone.
Do identify every zone by its real flag and its city name together.
Do derive dark-mode colours from the night set (*-night) with the same roles, not by inverting the daylight set.
Do thin the hour row on narrow screens by removing hours; never shrink the numerals to fit.
Do keep the working group low on a phone, under the thumb, and the copy actions within reach below it.
donts: Don't bring back cards, stacked per-zone rows, big tiles or a dial. Each was rejected as too bulky.
Don't use Sunset Ember for anything except a date that differs from the one shown and keyboard focus.
Don't add glow or gradient text. Gradients belong only inside the picture.
Don't replace the real flags with icons or emoji in the interface. Emoji flags appear only in the copied plain text.
Don't add an entrance animation. Content is present on first paint.
Don't add a second interface typeface.
